page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 128 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and it does not include discrete GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core processing capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU scores placing in the top 25% tier. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and PassMark database operations also demonstrate strong performance. Conversely, single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and single-threaded gzip compression, fall into the average tier. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks show average performance, while PassMark memory scores remain strong.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio represents a clear tradeoff, prioritizing raw parallel compute capacity over memory density. This configuration is highly efficient for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local NVMe storage. It is well-suited for multi-threaded batch processing, database operations, and small-scale LLM inference, where its strong multi-core execution and cryptographic acceleration flags can be fully leveraged.
